lexSnapshot.rootDefinitionHtml:
ن/ذ/ر   n–dh–r vow, to pledge to God, to pledge, to consecrate, votive offering
; to warn, to threaten, to admonish, to denote; harbinger, herald.

Of this root, 11 forms occur in 130 places in the Qur’an:
نَذَرَ nadhara 3 times; أَنْذَرَ ʾandhara 41 times; أُنْذِرَ ʾundhira 4 times; نَذْرٌ nadhr 2 times; نُذُورٌ nudhūr 1 time; نُذْرٌ nudhr 1 time; نَذِيرٌ nadhır 44 times; نُذُرٌ nudhur 14 times; مُنْذِرٌ mundhir 5 times; مُنْذِرُون mundhirūn 10 times and مُنْذَرون mundharūn 5 times.
lexSnapshot.mainDefinitionHtml:
أَنْذَرَ ʾandhara [v. IV] I [intrans.] to give warning, to carry out the act of warning

(74:2) قُمْ فَأَنْذِرْ arise and warn II [trans.]

1 to warn

(26:214) وَأَنْذِرْ عَشِيرَتَكَ الأَقْرَبِينَ and warn the nearest of your kinfolk

2 to proclaim, to declare

(16:2) أَنْذِرُوا أَنَّهُ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ أَنَا declare that there is no god but Me

3 to preach, to guide, to admonish

(6:19) وَأُوحِيَ إِلَيَّ هَذَا الْقُرْءَانُ لأُِنْذِرَكُمْ بِهِ وَمَنْ بَلَغَ and this Qur’an was revealed to me that with it I may warn you and everyone it reaches III [doubly trans.] to warn against

(41:13) أَنْذَرْتُكُمْ صَاعِقَةً مِثْلَ صَاعِقَةِ عَادٍ وَثَمُودَ I have warned you about a blast like the one of [which struck] ʿād and Thāmūd.

entries.label: أُنْذِر
entries.definitionHtml:

entries.label: مُنْذَرٌ
entries.definitionHtml:
مُنْذَرٌ mundhar [pass. part., pl. مُنْذَرُون mundharūn] one who is warned or admonished

entries.definitionHtml:

1 warning, admonishing

(79:45) إِنَّمَا أَنْتَ مُنْذِرُ مَنْ يَخْشَاهَا you are only warning those who stand in awe of it

2 a warner

(38:65) قُلْ إِنَّمَا أَنَا مُنْذِرٌ [Prophet] say, ‘I am but a warner.’

entries.label: نَذَرَ
entries.definitionHtml:
نَذَرَ nadhara i [v. trans.]

1 to vow

(19:26) إِنِّي نَذَرْتُ لِلرَّحْمَنِ صَوْمًا I have vowed to the Lord of Mercy a fast

2 to dedicate, to pledge;

(3:35) رَبِّ إِنِّي نَذَرْتُ لَكَ مَا فِى بَطْنِي مُحَرَّرًا Lord, I have dedicated what is in my womb entirely to You.

entries.label: نَذِيرٌ
entries.definitionHtml:
نَذِيرٌ nadhır [n./act. part., pl. نُذُرٌ nudhur]

1 warner, preacher/that which warns

(25:1) تَبَارَكَ الَّذِي نَزَّلَ الْفُرْقَانَ عَلَى عَبْدِهِ لِيَكُونَ لِلْعَالَمِينَ نَذِيرًا exalted is He who has sent down the Differentiator to His servant that it/he may be to all beings a warner

2 a warning

(67:17) فَسَتَعْلَمُونَ كَيْفَ نَذِيرِ you will come to know what My warning means.

entries.label: نَذْرٌ
entries.definitionHtml:
نَذْرٌ nadhr [n., pl. نُذُورٌ nudhūr] vow, pledge to God

(2:270) وَمَا أَنْفَقْتُمْ مِنْ نَفَقَةٍ أَوْ نَذَرْتُمْ مِنْ نَذْرٍ فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ يَعْلَمُهُ whatever donations you contribute or pledges you make, God surely knows it.

entries.label: نُذْرٌ
entries.definitionHtml:
نُذْرٌ nudhr [v. n.] the act of warning

(77:5–6) فَالْمُلْقِيَاتِ ذِكْراً عُذْرًا أَوْ نُذْرًا that which delivers a message to excuse or to warn.
